titlePl: Ósmoklasista: Zakupy i usługi — 36 haseł do gier LingoSpark
titleEn: Grade 8 English: Shopping & Services — 36 terms for LingoSpark games
blurbPl: Dział Zakupy i usługi: sklepy, płatność, reklamacja, usługi. Wklejasz do gier na LingoSpark.
blurbEn: Grade-8 Shopping module: shops, paying, refunds, services. Paste into LingoSpark games.

items.definitionEn: something sold at a very good, low price
items.example: These trainers were a real bargain in the sale.

items.definitionEn: an amount taken off the usual price
items.example: Students get a ten percent discount with this card.

items.definitionEn: a time when a shop sells things cheaper than usual
items.example: The winter sale starts on Boxing Day.

items.definitionEn: a piece of paper that proves you paid
items.example: Keep the receipt if you want to return the jumper.

items.definitionEn: money you get back when you return goods
items.example: They gave me a refund because the headphones were broken.

items.definitionEn: to give something back and get another size or item
items.example: Can I exchange this T-shirt for a larger size?

items.definitionEn: the place in a shop where you pay
items.example: Please pay at the cash desk near the door.

items.definitionEn: a plastic card you use to pay and pay the bank later
items.example: You can pay by credit card or in cash.

items.definitionEn: money in notes and coins, not a card
items.example: I did not have enough cash for the bus ticket.

items.definitionEn: to put on clothes in a shop to check the size
items.example: Always try on shoes before you buy them.

items.definitionEn: to be the right size for your body
items.example: These jeans do not fit — they are too tight.

items.definitionEn: how big or small a piece of clothing is
items.example: What size do you take in jackets?

items.definitionEn: looking at shop windows without buying
items.example: We went window shopping because we had no money.

items.definitionEn: a building with many shops together
items.example: The new shopping centre has a cinema on the top floor.

items.definitionEn: a large shop that sells many kinds of goods
items.example: You can buy clothes and kitchen tools in a department store.

items.definitionEn: a shop that sells food such as fruit, tins and rice
items.example: Buy some rice at the grocer's on the corner.

items.definitionEn: a shop that sells meat
items.example: Mum bought chicken at the butcher's.

items.definitionEn: a shop that sells bread and cakes
items.example: There is always a queue at the baker's on Saturday.

items.definitionEn: a shop that sells newspapers, magazines and sweets
items.example: He bought a magazine at the newsagent's.

items.definitionEn: a line of people waiting
items.example: There was a long queue at the cash desk.

items.definitionEn: a person who buys something in a shop
items.example: The shop assistant asked the customer if she needed help.

items.definitionEn: the name of a company that makes a product
items.example: Some people only buy one brand of trainers.

items.definitionEn: already used by someone else; not new
items.example: I bought a second-hand bike and saved a lot of money.

items.definitionEn: buying goods on the internet
items.example: Online shopping is easy but you cannot try clothes on.

items.definitionEn: bringing goods to your home
items.example: The delivery should arrive on Thursday.

items.definitionEn: costing a lot of money
items.example: That jacket is too expensive for a school coat.

items.definitionEn: costing little money
items.example: These pens are cheap but they break quickly.

items.definitionPl: opłacalny, dobry stosunek jakości do ceny
items.definitionEn: good quality for the price you pay
items.example: The lunch menu is excellent value for money.

items.definitionEn: a shop where you have your hair cut
items.example: I have an appointment at the hairdresser's at four.

items.definitionEn: a place where you send letters and parcels
items.example: Take this parcel to the post office.

items.definitionEn: an arrangement with a bank to keep your money
items.example: You need a bank account to get pocket money transferred.

items.definitionEn: to take money out of a bank account
items.example: You can withdraw cash from the machine outside.

items.definitionEn: a machine that gives you cash from your account
items.example: The ATM on the high street is out of order.

items.definitionEn: to have enough money to buy something
items.example: We cannot afford a new laptop this month.

items.definitionEn: how much you must pay for something
items.example: The price of butter has gone up again.

items.definitionEn: staying open after the usual closing time
items.example: The chemist is open late on Thursdays.
